messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync request — enterprise customer needs a private deployment (SSO + optional on‑prem). Target launch window: ~3 weeks. Can we align owners, gating, and resource choreography?
Alex (Eng): Need throughput and latency SLOs, and which model variant exactly.
Maya (PM): SLOs: p99 < 500ms for chat gen, steady 8 rps. Model: LlamaX-70B quantized. CS told me onboarding estimate is 3w.
Sam (Runtime): 70B quantized FP4 at 8 rps is feasible but we'll need 8x A100-80GB equiv or similar. KV cache warmup + batching config will be key. Recommend a 10% canary.
Jordan (Infra): Reserved Dedicated pool + VPC peering required. Spin-up ETA: ~5 business days after signed PO (cloud quota permitting).
Lina (Security): SSO + audit logs + KMS/HSM for keys. Need a security review + threat model. Earliest review slot Thursday — please provide data flow diagram.
Priya (CS): I'll collect customer requirements, PII matrix, and confirm whether they truly need an air‑gapped on‑prem option (that adds 3–4w).
Ken (SRE): Runbook asks: deploy/playbook, rollback triggers, alerting thresholds, runbook-run drill. We should draft and do a tabletop before canary.
Maya (PM): Proposed launch gates: 1) capacity verification, 2) security signoff, 3) canary metrics pass, 4) SRE runbook validated. If any gate fails, fallback to hosted API.
Alex (Eng): Agreed. For capacity verification we need a perf harness and acceptance thresholds. Sam, can you propose tests + pass criteria?
Sam (Runtime): Will do. Quick harness idea below and pass criteria.
Sam (Runtime): ```bash
# perf harness example
wrk -t12 -c50 -d60s http://canary.local/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Sam (Runtime): Acceptance: p99 < 550ms, error rate < 0.2%. Also measure memory / GPU saturation during 5min ramp.
Jordan (Infra): Note: customer VPC requires subnet peering + NAT + route tables. I'll raise infra tickets and estimate time to provision.
Lina (Security): Need KMS policy draft and audit log retention policy. Who can own KMS policy? @Alex?
Alex (Eng): I can own the KMS policy draft.
Maya (PM): Owners capture: Alex (implementation + KMS), Sam (perf + canary), Jordan (infra), Lina (security), Ken (runbook), Priya (customer comms).
Priya (CS): I'll schedule weekly check-ins with the customer and prepare the onboarding doc and data residency answers.
Maya (PM): Timeline sketch: week0 signed -> week1 infra + security review -> week2 perf + canary -> week3 full handover. Call out blockers early.
Jordan (Infra): Cloud quota for reserved GPUs is a blocker — I'll escalate to cloud provider.
Ken (SRE): Can we do a 30m runbook runthrough before the canary? Suggest Wed 10:30 — can people make that?
Maya (PM): I'll send the invite for Wed 10:30.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "Customer Private Deploy - Readiness" 2024-03-24 10:30
Alex (Eng): I'll open a small RFC for the rollout config. Sketch of the canary policy: {"canary_percent":"10","metrics":["p99_latency","error_rate"],"rollback":{"p99_latency":">=700ms","error_rate":">=1%"}}
Maya (PM): Good. Let's put progress updates in this thread daily. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): FYI customer asked for explicit data residency doc; I'll ping legal for quick signoff.
Lina (Security): Security review ticket created: SEC-498. Please attach DF diagram and list of required logs.
Sam (Runtime): Perf harness PR drafted: https://git.company/infra/perf-harness/pull/12
Alex (Eng): KMS policy PR: https://git.company/infra/pull/256
Jordan (Infra): Infra tickets opened: INFRA-1123 (VPC peering), INFRA-1124 (reserved GPU pool).
Ken (SRE): Added runbook checklist to runbooks repo: https://git.company/runbooks/private-deploy.md
Maya (PM): Thanks all. If anyone hits slippage or needs more runway call it out here. We'll reconvene after the canary. End of thread.
